split_by: primary use: typing/first mechanical keyboard (Keychron V1 Max, best all-rounder), both gaming and everyday use or work (Keychron K2 HE), competitive gaming/competitive shooters (Wooting 80HE / 80HE+), spend hours writing (Lofree Flow 2 84), general-purpose wireless rather than dedicated competitive-gaming (NuPhy Air75 V3)

price: $65.99 (EPOMAKER × AULA F75, best budget / spend less), $87.49 (Keychron K3 Max, best value / tighter budget), $101.99 (Keychron V1 Max, all-rounder), $103.99 (Keychron K2 HE, value pick), $139.95 (NuPhy Air75 V3 best overall low-profile; NuPhy Air60 HE), $159.00 (Lofree Flow 2 84, best premium typing), $175.00 (Lofree Flow 2 100, best with number pad), $199.99 / $249.99 (Wooting 80HE+ / 80HE, competitive gaming; roughly twice as much as the Keychron)

switch type: Brown (tactile bump), Red (smooth press), silent switches (shared office / if noise matters), magnetic Hall Effect (adjustable actuation and Rapid Trigger, for competitive gaming / repeated movement inputs)

layout: 75% with arrow and function keys (compact, versatile picks), 60% low-profile (short keys, maximum mouse space, sacrifices arrow and function keys), 84 (Lofree Flow 2 84), 96% (number pad in a space-saving layout)
connectivity: wired only (Wooting 80HE, NuPhy Air60 HE), wireless or USB / 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth (Keychron V1 Max, K2 HE, K3 Max, Lofree Flow 2 100)
polling rate: 8,000 Hz (Wooting 80HE), 1,000 Hz (Keychron K2 HE, a main compromise versus Wooting; K3 Max wired)
software: excellent Wootility configuration (Wooting, competitive pick), less polished (Keychron K2 HE), less flexible (AULA F75), excellent remapping / QMK/VIA (Keychron V1 Max, K3 Max)
case material: plastic (Keychron V1 Max, Wooting 80HE), weaker case (AULA F75), solid/full aluminum (Lofree Flow 2, premium typing experience)
key profile: low-profile short, laptop-like keys (NuPhy Air60 HE, Air75 V3, Lofree, K3 Max) vs standard
typing feel: soft, cushioned (AULA F75; NuPhy Air75 V3 slightly cushioned, gasket-mounted), refined typing feel (Lofree Flow 2 84)
